name: judgeval-reversible-llm-instrumentation-sessions
instr:
judgeval cannot temporarily suspend tracing and later restore provider clients exactly while several components instrument the same client. Add reversible sessions without changing client identity or provider behavior. Existing `wrap` use must retain permanent instrumentation.

`instrument` returns an open `InstrumentationSession` exposing the identical supplied client and sharing ownership across sessions. Lifecycle operations are idempotent. Tracing is enabled while any owner is active, paused when none is active, and original callable identities are restored only after the final owner closes. Each invocation makes one instrumentation decision when its observable operation begins and keeps it through completion, explicit closure, or failure. Provider calls, values, chunks, resources, and exceptions remain unchanged.

This applies to OpenAI chat, responses, parsed completions, images, raw responses, and streaming-response helpers; Anthropic messages, iterators, and managed streams; Google generate-content; and Together-compatible clients. OpenAI image streams retain accumulated usage. Raw-response helpers retain existing bypass and response-ownership behavior. Anthropic managed streams keep their entry-time decision through normal or exceptional exit. Google stays synchronous-only, with no unsupported asynchronous instrumentation surface. `wrap` returns the original client with existing provider-specific tracing, streaming, and error behavior, without session management.
